milestones.title: Prove the foundations
milestones.outcome: Roster/still look locked, Forest refresh committed and economy structure approved. Close fresh-reset parity before Oct 25 native Fernlands proof; measure capacity and settle initial ops/device decisions.

work.title: Repair fresh reset, then prove Fernlands on phones
work.why: Moto/local-stack reset exposed Forest/Fernlands roster leakage. The existing harness seeds before migrations; real reset seeds after them. A working repair exists, but prior 40-species reports do not prove that path.
work.doneWhen: Verify fresh seed-last bootstrap, exact 40 homes/eight shops/Books/starters, no missing or zero-price entries, and a runner that fails on script errors. Then authorized Fernlands native full loop/OS kill-relaunch by Oct 25; all-five by Nov 1, with iOS coverage.

work.title: Benchmark the 19 missing packages
work.why: 21 ranch banks and 21 dedicated reveals exist; 19 new species banks remain missing. Seven Forest personality/reveal updates are committed, while newer Aquilops/Kentro/Para/Shuno bank work is uncommitted. This is useful pipeline evidence, not throughput for 19 new bodies.
work.doneWhen: Agree the next production scope/method/spending, time one full Iguanodon package and bounded Titanoboa/Mammoth proofs. Today’s 19 missing over 19 days to Nov 8 is 7/week before rework, look checks, worlds and QA. Count complete accepted packages, not refreshed portraits.

work.title: Verify reset parity and final 40-species data
work.why: All 40 are defined, but committed seed-last inspection implies 36 present and only 32 in correct homes. Those counts are inferred, not measured. Working seed repair and actual reset-order proof remain.
work.doneWhen: Prove true fresh bootstrap and parity with the sequential migration path before using data for final pacing/native acceptance. Preserve approved Forest ladder and Fernlands order; later numeric profiles and unshown tier maps remain candidates.

work.title: See what alpha players do
work.why: Build 706 Android ingestion and four alpha dashboard insights are verified (#45 Done). Broader coverage is tracked in #60.
work.doneWhen: Review QA-excluded cohorts as time elapses; add observed progression, pacing and pity coverage. Empty charts do not establish retention.

work.title: Qualify current banks and finish motion faults
work.why: Forest seven-look refresh and Stegouros dedicated reveal/video controller are committed. Herd Call island scope is corrected; Moto review still shows callout/card clipping, a partial Zoomies recovery cue and unqualified performance outliers.
work.doneWhen: Close demonstrated #64 UI/runner defects and qualify retained motion, reveal and ability changes. Preserve separately owned uncommitted banks; report exact candidate/source and native limits rather than a blanket suite pass.

work.title: Prove recovery before adding more content
work.why: Historical hosted backup/restore, crash receipt and staging capacity evidence is incomplete. Discover limits this week.
work.doneWhen: Confirm backup configuration, crash alert receipt and minimum-device baseline Oct 25; isolated hosted restore and load rehearsal by Nov 1.

work.title: Calibrate the approved economy structure
work.why: Oct 20 decision approves later 2/2/2/1/1 ladders, shown Fernlands order, sellable island specials, cumulative admitted dig-found gates, finite fair offline storage and post-Giants island/event crafts. Final numeric profiles, rates, counts and bills remain candidates.
work.doneWhen: Verify seed-last parity; couple special and ordinary ingredients, coin spending, Bag/events and recipes in the exact-current-input attendance model. Retain the local uncommitted fair-admission proof as source evidence, then select numbers with Frozair. Model sensitivities do not establish player pacing.

work.title: Finish the five island casts + worlds
work.why: All 40 stills and roster definitions are locked. Sequential fixtures have prior integration evidence; true fresh-reset parity needs repair. Nineteen ranch banks are missing, existing banks need final identity/motion/native checks, and all five worlds/expansions remain.
work.doneWhen: All 40 pass movement/actions, hatch/reveal, variants, eggs, Book, voice coverage and their island expansion stages. Measure complete accepted output, including rework; escalate any capacity/date conflict without automatic roster cuts.

work.title: Prove phone performance + recovery
work.why: Older debug captures cannot certify the final release build.
work.doneWhen: First backup/monitoring and device baseline by Oct 25; isolated hosted restore and staging load by Nov 1; final candidate recovery/endurance regression by Nov 15.

work.title: Start the public-store checklist
work.why: Age/privacy decisions, listing assets and public review can block an otherwise finished game.
work.doneWhen: Resolve project’s audience/sign-in requirement, align disclosures, finish assets and submit both public builds Nov 16.

work.title: Sky after the first five
work.why: Frozair prefers Sky to Water. Flying routes add a separate production/motion problem.
work.doneWhen: Choose next-island scope after the five-island release is stable.

decisions.title: The 40 and their homes are locked
decisions.recommendation: Frozair approved the complete five-island roster. Iguanodon and Brachio are in Fernlands; the revised Snow eight are fixed. Casting is complete; final art and native acceptance remain.

decisions.title: Economy structure approved; choose final numbers
decisions.recommendation: Oct 20: island ladders, one sellable special per island, cumulative admitted dig-found gate progress, finite fair offline storage and post-Giants island/event crafting are approved. Forest ladder/abilities are committed; Fernlands tier order accepted. Other exact tier maps, numeric stage profiles, special rates, gate counts and recipe bills remain candidates.

decisions.title: Paid launch or free launch?
decisions.recommendation: Choose one small, proven purchase loop only if it fits. Otherwise launch free and schedule monetisation next. Full pass/catalog is a proposed deferral.

decisions.title: Which phones do we promise?
decisions.recommendation: Agree minimum Android/iPhone devices and budgets. Android is available; #56 reports no iOS device. Arrange iOS coverage for the Oct 25 proof; a separate Mystery Egg Bag Moto debug pass does not qualify the launch five.

decisions.title: Does the measured pace fit Nov 8?
decisions.recommendation: Compare accepted full packages and world/data work with remaining capacity. If the forecast misses, remove optional features first, then ask Frozair to choose resources/date tradeoffs. Do not silently cut residents.

decisions.title: Approve the next creature production step
decisions.recommendation: All 40 selected stills are approved; no further video spending is authorized. Review a costed method and spending limit for one full Iguanodon package plus bounded body proofs before new production. Preserve current Rex and Leafy.

risks.title: Fresh reset mixes island rosters
risks.action: Real reset seeds after migrations; older local harness seeds before them. Moto exposed foreign/missing/zero-price Forest entries. A seed repair is working-only. Verify actual bootstrap order and all 40 correct homes before pacing/native acceptance; do not claim the older suite proves this path.

risks.title: 19 new banks plus qualification
risks.action: Oct 20 still finds 19 missing banks. At 19 days to Nov 8, the floor is 7 new complete packages/week before look matching, worlds, reveals, rework and QA. Forest refresh is progress, not proof of sustainable output across new bodies. Check measured capacity Oct 25.

risks.title: Unproven body types and wetland behavior
risks.action: Prove Mammoth weight, Titanoboa continuous motion and aquatic residents’ water access early. Validate 16 residents, duplicate mixes and service clearance; still concepts are insufficient.

risks.title: Native five-island proof is still missing
risks.action: Sequential source fixtures have recorded loop evidence; real fresh-reset parity needs repair and verification first. Next approved build: Fernlands native proof by Oct 25, all five by Nov 1, including iOS coverage. Hosted launch rollout is separate.

risks.title: Progression still unproved
risks.action: Economy structure is approved; local fair-admission correction and exact-input model have scoped proof. Verify actual reset parity and couple Bag/events/recipes/coin spending before numerical locks. Candidate sensitivities are not forecasts for players.

risks.title: Public review is external
risks.action: Start setup now; submit Nov 16 and protect the final fortnight for fixes.

risks.title: Recovery is not yet proven
risks.action: Recheck dated backup/monitoring gaps now. Initial proof Oct 25, hosted isolated restore and staging load Nov 1; final regression Nov 15.

launchGates.label: Five meaningful islands
launchGates.proof: Eight accepted species per island, 40 total. Each island: unlock, arrival, shop, hatch/reveal, work, collect/sell, every expansion, Book and offline return.

launchGates.label: Understandable progression
launchGates.proof: Fresh-player and ordinary-return observations; credible normal-dino gate route, no ultra-rare requirement. Exact values approved.

launchGates.label: Stable release phones
launchGates.proof: Both OSes, minimum supported devices, repeated travel/hatch/shop, 16 residents/duplicate variants, endurance and retry cases pass agreed limits.

launchGates.label: Saves + operations
launchGates.proof: Update/reinstall/account-link recovery, hosted backup and isolated restore, crash receipt, load/rollback evidence. No known critical data or duplication faults.

launchGates.label: Both stores approved
launchGates.proof: Public approvals for the exact candidates; listings, disclosures, audience/deletion path and any paid receipt/odds flows complete.

launchGates.label: Director acceptance
launchGates.proof: Frozair approves island readability, motion, reveal delight and collection identity from final native play.

deferred.title: Water / Lagoon
deferred.reason: Water is inactive WIP in the new launch source configuration. Frozair approved a fresh-start pre-release reset policy, but this maintenance task executes no hosted reset or rollout.

deferred.title: Sky, Riverbend and extra islands
deferred.reason: Sky is Frozair’s preferred future candidate. Finish and stabilise five first.

deferred.title: Full season pass + broad premium catalog
deferred.reason: Proposed cut pending Oct 25 revenue decision. One validated paid loop is the maximum recommendation.

deferred.title: New hybrids, decor and art rewrites
deferred.reason: Proposed postlaunch work unless needed to fix a demonstrated launch-blocking defect.

changes.text: New first priority: #64 fresh-reset seed order can mix Forest/Fernlands shops; working repair still needs actual reset validation. Seven Forest looks/reveals plus ladder/abilities committed; Stegouros fallback retired, dedicated reveals now 21. Economy structure approved; final numbers remain candidates. Missing banks stay 19.

All 40 now seeded in approved source homes, eight per shop/Book, with five active islands and recorded local loop proof. Native/hosted launch rollout and final balance remain open; 19 still use placeholder art. Selected still baseline approved, Rex reveal committed. Fresh-start decision retires legacy relocation work.

Frozair locked all 40 species and island homes. Casting review closed. Fresh source audit: 21 committed ranch banks, 19 missing; 14/40 obtainable anywhere, 10/40 in intended homes. Para/Kentro are committed; Dilophosaurus has banks. Fernlands phone slice and production benchmark lead the updated plan.

Recommended habitat revision: Iguanodon → greener Fernlands; Nanuqsaurus, Prince Creek Edmontosaurus, Leaellynasaura and Woolly Rhinoceros proposed for Snow. Borealopelta, Cryolophosaurus, Citipati and Concavenator benched in this proposal. Eight per island/40 total and all milestone dates stay; no game data changes.
Frozair superseded 28 with 40 launch species: eight per island. Brachio → Fernlands; Paraceratherium out. Supporting moves remain proposals. Dates stay; capacity must be proved.
Analytics #45 Done: build 706 Android ingestion and four alpha dashboard insights verified. Coverage follow-up is #60; retention needs elapsed, non-QA cohorts.

evidence.detail: #64 Moto local-stack dba02dac2 found Fernlands species in Forest/Buy0. Current committed seed.sql applies Forest ladder and restock only; the working patch also restores Fernlands donors/home moves. egg_load_db harness seeds early while real db reset seeds last. Inspection implies 36/40 IDs present and 32/40 correct homes in committed reset order; not a newly measured DB result. Working repair is not committed/reset-validated.

Fair offline admission has recorded 124 focused + 308 storage checks in an uncommitted seven-path package. Maintained model includes 16 tests/1,000 SQL-profile comparisons; rates, later profiles, gates and recipe bills remain candidates and the harness does not prove seed-last parity.

Neither is complete Fernlands/all-five native, iOS, thermal or final release proof. Moto returned to hosted build; hosted launch rollout was not verified by this review.

Cross-island routing/Nursery/hatch fixes have snapshot-specific local evidence; later Game/Batch changes mean old counts are not a fresh full HEAD pass. 19 missing / 19 days to Nov 8 × 7 = 7 new packages/week minimum.
